post.text: We're relaunching the Glow Skin store before Black Friday and looking for a Shopify developer to rebuild our DTC setup and make it faster on mobile. Recommendations?

company.name: Glow Skin
company.description: Glow Skin makes clean, plant-based skincare.

audit_facts.statement: The homepage HTML took 4.2 seconds to download in our test.
The homepage title is "Glow Skin | Clean skincare".
The homepage has no mobile viewport meta tag.
The homepage has a call-to-action button ("Shop now").
The site appears to be built with Shopify.
9 of 14 images on the homepage have no alt attribute.
